svg.aria-label: Scenario 5, daily deep learning. You ask: New idea for the model — let's try it today. In your session: step 1, /research-master:research-mentor discusses and returns advice that separates what the evidence supports from what is plausible; its own ideas go to HYPOTHESES.md with status: proposed, and it never asserts its own ideas as facts. On the way to verification sits the sparring gate: it fires before advice that spends more than the project's compute threshold or changes a claim or the scope, at the design phase of a large plan, or when you and the mentor agreed a direction-level call within one exchange, and pre-registrations keep their own gates, sparring being optional there; when it fires, sparring-partner is dispatched across the context boundary with the proposal as written plus its evidence paths, never the mentor's own reasoning, and its Independent audit — PROCEED, PROCEED-WITH-CHANGES or RETHINK — opens the mentor's answer; the audit advises, you decide; it is advice, never a veto. Step 2, /research-master:math-reviewer verifies the theory and returns a verification report, one line per claim, correct, wrong, fragile or unverified; it never implements, a fix is handed to dl-engineer. Step 3, /research-master:dl-engineer implements, returns complete code and a one-line memory and latency impact, never self-certifies, and after any change to an encoder, core block, collator or optimizer writes the hand-off line → run regression-guardian. Step 4, across the context boundary, dispatch regression-guardian: the gate certifies or rejects, returning exactly one verdict with the test output — PASS, PASS-BUT-UNGUARDED or FAIL; it never fixes code and never certifies from a partial run. A FAIL — which test, the minimal repro, the behavioral symptom, not a fix — comes back through you: the fix goes to /dl-engineer, which hands off to the gate again. Once certified, Lane 1 continues: step 5 experiment-runner runs, step 6 /results-analyst analyzes, step 7 repo-maintainer commits. Footnote, dl-engineer hard rule 5: Never self-certify. After any change to an encoder, core block, collator, or optimizer, the change is not correct until regression-guardian says so.
svg.title: Scenario 5 — a new idea for the model, tried today
